recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-16198 behavior in current build-scope source; questions about SMART scopes, exact purge side effects, or 404-vs-410 behavior should be handled as separate WG decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-16198 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core REST. The final resolution requested DELETE [base]/[type]/[id]/_history, DELETE [base]/[type]/[id]/_history/[vid], delete-history and delete-history-version CapabilityStatement interaction codes, POST /Patient/[id]/$purge, POST /Group/[id]/$purge, async suitability for $purge, and links from the HTTP delete section.
initial_application: The issue was applied through 2023 commits including 79f7e6eb3ee for Patient $purge and HTTP delete-page linkage and c2724e8a568 for the delete-history HTTP sections/table rows. FHIR-42728/b4ae65a387 covered the RESTful interaction code and CapabilityStatement surfaces. A later 992dff4a2fa commit split $purge into Patient and Group definitions but left scope/identity/state metadata inconsistent.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and Zulip discussions confirm that delete-history covers single-resource history deletion while $purge covers Patient-compartment deletion, including Patient and Group entry points. The related FHIR-42728 interaction-code decision is already reflected in current source and was not separately decided.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html to link both Patient $purge and Group $purge and explicitly state that delete-history-version cannot remove the current version. Updated Patient-purge to apply only to Patient and to mark the operation state-changing. Updated Group-purge to use Group-purge id/canonical metadata, declare Group scope, describe Patient compartments of Group members, include standard OperationDefinition metadata, and mark the operation state-changing.
source_changes: source/http.html: linked both Patient $purge and Group $purge in the delete section and added the current-version error rule for delete-history-version.
source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-purge.xml: removed the unintended Group resource scope and changed affectsState to true.

source/group/operationdefinition-Group-purge.xml: corrected id/url/name/status/publication metadata, added Group resource scope, clarified Group-member Patient compartment semantics, and changed affectsState to true.

related_jiras.note: Same change family for RESTful interaction codes; current source already contains delete-history and delete-history-version, so it was not separately decided.
